changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS document.product_requests ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, contract_id UUID NOT NULL, product_id UUID, buyer_in TEXT, seller_in TEXT, requester_in TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', reason TEXT, deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_product_requests_contract ON document.product_requests (contract_id) WHERE deleted = false;
